candidates.name: Southwest Solutions Group
candidates.partition_evidence: The homepage lists wire partition cages and modular restrooms (prefab buildings), and it has a 'Springfield Sales Team' in Missouri. The homepage never mentions toilet, bathroom or restroom partitions.
red_flags: Storage and modular-building company, not toilet partitions
'Partition' on its site means wire cages
candidates.reason: A storage, shelving and modular-building firm with a Springfield, MO sales team. Its site offers wire partition cages and modular restrooms, not toilet partitions.

candidates.name: DH Pace Company (Springfield branch)
candidates.partition_evidence: Sells bathroom partitions (powder coated steel, stainless, phenolic, plastic laminate, HDPE) and replacement hardware. Its Division 10 page says it offers 'all-inclusive supply only packages for Division 10 material'. No partition installation shown.
red_flags: Door and dock company, partitions are a side line
candidates.reason: DH Pace has a branch in Springfield and sells toilet partitions, but its Division 10 page describes supply-only packages and shows no partition installation. It is a competing supplier, not an installer.

Only project record found dates from 2011, so it may be inactive
